description: This Java class 'InventoryServiceClient' acts as a client for the inventory service, responsible for reserving inventory stock via REST API calls. It encapsulates HTTP request logic, error handling, and integrates with Spring WebClient.

classes.name: InventoryServiceClient
classes.description: A Spring component for communicating with the inventory service to reserve stock, handle responses, and throw customized exceptions on failure.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Sends a reservation request to the inventory service API, handling conflict or error responses, and returning the inventory stock response.

methods.name: InventoryReserveFailedException
methods.description: Custom exception indicating reservation failure due to insufficient inventory.

methods.name: InventoryServiceClientException
methods.description: Custom exception for general client errors during interaction with inventory service.
